2	extends Node2D
3	## Straw Scarecrow: walks down to the wall and hits the gate. Straw burns.
4	## Owns the Burning state: burn_time_left > 0 means burning. Fire refreshes it to the full
5	## BURN_DURATION (a second hit does not stack damage). Timed in physics time, so it follows
6	## Engine.time_scale and stops while the tree is paused.
7	
8	signal burning_started
9	signal burning_ended
10	signal died
11	signal attacking_gate(amount: float)
12	
13	var hp: float = Tuning.SCARECROW_HP
14	var burn_time_left: float = 0.0
15	var at_wall := false
16	
17	
18	func _ready() -> void:
19		add_to_group("enemies")
20		at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
21	
22	
23	func is_burning() -> bool:
24		return burn_time_left > 0.0
25	
26	
27	func is_dead() -> bool:
28		return hp <= 0.0
29	
30	
31	func hit(damage: float, element: StringName) -> void:
32		if is_dead():
33			return
34		hp -= damage
35		if element == &"fire":
36			ignite()
37		_check_death()
38	
39	
40	func ignite() -> void:
41		var was_burning := is_burning()
42		burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION
43		if not was_burning:
44			burning_started.emit()
45	
46	
47	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
48		if is_dead() or is_queued_for_deletion():   # a reset in the same tick must not hit the gate
49			return
50		if is_burning():
51			var burned := minf(delta, burn_time_left)
52			hp -= Tuning.BURN_DPS * burned
53			burn_time_left -= delta
54			if burn_time_left <= 0.0:
55				burn_time_left = 0.0
56				burning_ended.emit()
57			_check_death()
58			if is_dead():
59				return
60		if at_wall:
61			attacking_gate.emit(Tuning.SCARECROW_GATE_DPS * delta)
62		else:
63			position.y = minf(position.y + Tuning.SCARECROW_SPEED * delta, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
64			at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
65	
66	
67	func _check_death() -> void:
68		if is_dead():
69			remove_from_group("enemies")
70			died.emit()
71			queue_free()
72

1	class_name Game
2	extends Node2D
3	## One prototype run: survive SURVIVE_TIME seconds of scarecrows without losing the gate.
4	## Owns the run state (gate HP, elapsed time, kills, win/lose). Restart with R/Enter at the end.
5	
6	signal state_changed(new_state: State)
7	
8	enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }
9	
10	const SCARECROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/scarecrow.tscn")
11	const ARCHER_START := Vector2(640, 572)
12	
13	@export var spawning_enabled := true
14	## (start, end) spawn interval used instead of Tuning's when non-zero; only tools/balance_sim.gd sets it.
15	var spawn_interval_override := Vector2.ZERO
16	
17	var state: State = State.PLAYING
18	var gate_hp: float = Tuning.GATE_HP
19	var elapsed := 0.0
20	var kills := 0
21	var spawn_timer := 0.0
22	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
23	
24	@onready var world: Node2D = $World
25	@onready var enemies: Node2D = $World/Enemies
26	@onready var arrows: Node2D = $World/Arrows
27	@onready var archer: Archer = $World/Archer
28	
29	
30	func _ready() -> void:
31		rng.randomize()
32		archer.arrows_parent = arrows
33		reset()
34	
35	
36	func reset() -> void:
37		for child in enemies.get_children() + arrows.get_children():
38			if child.is_in_group("enemies"):
39				child.remove_from_group("enemies")
40			child.queue_free()
41		gate_hp = Tuning.GATE_HP
42		elapsed = 0.0
43		kills = 0
44		spawn_timer = 1.0
45		archer.position = ARCHER_START
46		archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
47		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
48		_set_state(State.PLAYING)
49	
50	
51	func spawn_scarecrow(at: Vector2) -> Scarecrow:
52		var s := SCARECROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Scarecrow
53		s.position = at
54		s.died.connect(func() -> void: kills += 1)
55		s.attacking_gate.connect(_on_attacking_gate)
56		enemies.add_child(s)
57		return s
58	
59	
60	func spawn_interval() -> float:
61		var t := clampf(elapsed / Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
62		if spawn_interval_override != Vector2.ZERO:
63			return lerpf(spawn_interval_override.x, spawn_interval_override.y, t)
64		return lerpf(Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START, Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END, t)
65	
66	
67	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
68		if state != State.PLAYING:
69			return
70		elapsed += delta
71		if elapsed >= Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME:
72			_end(State.WON)
73			return
74		if spawning_enabled:
75			spawn_timer -= delta
76			if spawn_timer <= 0.0:
77				spawn_timer += spawn_interval()
78				spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(rng.randf_range(60.0, Tuning.VIEW.x - 60.0), -40.0))
79	
80	
81	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
82		if state != State.PLAYING and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
83			reset()
84	
85	
86	func _on_attacking_gate(amount: float) -> void:
87		if state != State.PLAYING:
88			return
89		gate_hp = maxf(gate_hp - amount, 0.0)
90		if gate_hp <= 0.0:
91			_end(State.LOST)
92	
93	
94	func _end(result: State) -> void:
95		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED   # freeze the field; HUD shows the result
96		_set_state(result)
97	
98	
99	func _set_state(s: State) -> void:
100		state = s
101		state_changed.emit(s)
102

extends SceneTree
## Game-rule checks for the Mimic Keep prototype, run through the real main scene and game loop.
##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_rules.gd --fixed-fps 60
## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0          # physics ticks per second is the project default, 60

var passed := 0
var failed := 0
var game: Game


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame

	await _test_spawning()
	await _test_holds_fire_without_target()
	await _test_fire_arrow_ignites_and_kills()
	await _test_burn_duration_and_damage()
	await _test_burn_retrigger_refreshes()
	await _test_burn_under_time_scale()
	await _test_burn_frozen_while_paused()
	await _test_gate_damage_and_loss()
	await _test_survive_to_win()

	print("test_rules: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _ticks(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame


func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
	await _ticks(roundi(s / TICK))


## Clean field, archer on or off, spawning off.
func _fresh(archer_on: bool) -> void:
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	game.reset()
	game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT if archer_on else Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await process_frame


## Game time, summed from the delta the engine hands to _physics_process (so it follows
## Engine.time_scale exactly, including the one tick a time_scale change takes to apply).
class GameClock extends Node:
	var total := 0.0
	var ticks := 0
	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
		total += delta
		ticks += 1


## Runs until the scarecrow's Burning ends; returns [game seconds, physics ticks] since the call.
func _measure_burn(s: Scarecrow, max_ticks: int = 2000) -> Array:
	var clock := GameClock.new()
	root.add_child(clock)
	var rec := {"done": false}
	s.burning_ended.connect(func() -> void: rec.done = true, CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
	while not rec.done and clock.ticks < max_ticks:
		await physics_frame
	var out := [clock.total, clock.ticks]
	clock.queue_free()
	return out


# --- checks ----------------------------------------------------------------

func _test_spawning() -> void:
	await _fresh(false)
	game.rng.seed = 7
	game.spawning_enabled = true
	await _seconds(1.1)
	_check("first scarecrow spawns after 1 s", game.enemies.get_child_count() == 1,
			"got %d" % game.enemies.get_child_count())
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	game.elapsed = 0.0
	_check("spawn interval starts at %.1f s" % Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START,
			is_equal_approx(game.spawn_interval(), Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START))
	game.elapsed = Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME
	_check("spawn interval reaches %.1f s at the end" % Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END,
			is_equal_approx(game.spawn_interval(), Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END))
	game.spawning_enabled = false


func _test_holds_fire_without_target() -> void:
	await _fresh(true)
	var rec := {"shots": 0}
	var count := func(_a: Arrow) -> void: rec.shots += 1
	game.archer.fired.connect(count)
	await _seconds(1.0)
	_check("archer holds fire with no scarecrow in the cone", rec.shots == 0, "shots=%d" % rec.shots)

	await _fresh(true)
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(640, 250))
	var rec := {"started": 0}
	s.burning_started.connect(func() -> void: rec.started += 1)
	var t := 0.0

		await physics_frame
		t += TICK

	t = 0.0

		await physics_frame
		t += TICK
	await process_frame

	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(200, 100))
	var rec := {"started": 0}
	s.burning_started.connect(func() -> void: rec.started += 1)
	s.ignite()
	await _seconds(2.0)

func _test_burn_frozen_while_paused() -> void:

	s.ignite()
	await _seconds(1.0)
	paused = true

	_check("Burning resumes after unpause", s.burn_time_left < left)


func _test_gate_damage_and_loss() -> void:
	await _fresh(false)

	_check("the field freezes after a loss", game.world.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED)


func _test_survive_to_win() -> void:
	await _fresh(false)
	await _seconds(Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME + 0.1)
	_check("surviving %.0f s wins the run" % Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, game.state == Game.State.WON,
			"state=%d elapsed=%.2f" % [game.state, game.elapsed])
	game.reset()
	_check("reset restores the gate and the clock",
			game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.gate_hp == Tuning.GATE_HP and game.elapsed == 0.0)

## Keyboard checks: real InputEventKey events through Input.parse_input_event, into the main scene.
##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_input.gd --fixed-fps 60
## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0

var passed := 0
var failed := 0
var game: Game


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame

	await _test_move(KEY_D, 1.0, "D")
	await _test_move(KEY_RIGHT, 1.0, "Right arrow")
	await _test_move(KEY_A, -1.0, "A")
	await _test_move(KEY_LEFT, -1.0, "Left arrow")
	await _test_clamp()
	await _test_pause(KEY_ESCAPE, "Esc")
	await _test_pause(KEY_P, "P")
	await _test_restart()

	print("test_input: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
	for i in roundi(s / TICK):
		await physics_frame


func _test_move(code: Key, sign_x: float, label: String) -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	var x0 := game.archer.position.x
	_key(code, true)
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_key(code, false)
	await _seconds(0.1)
	var moved := game.archer.position.x - x0
	var expect := sign_x * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * 0.5
	_check("%s moves the archer %+.0f px in 0.5 s" % [label, expect],
			absf(moved - expect) <= Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK + 0.01, "moved %.2f" % moved)


func _test_clamp() -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	await _seconds(3.0)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_check("the archer stops at the right edge",
			is_equal_approx(game.archer.position.x, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN),
			"x=%.2f" % game.archer.position.x)


func _test_pause(code: Key, label: String) -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s pauses" % label, paused)
	var t := game.elapsed
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_check("%s: the run clock stops while paused" % label, game.elapsed == t)
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s resumes" % label, not paused)


func _test_restart() -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	game.gate_hp = 50.0
	_key(KEY_R, true)
	_key(KEY_R, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("R does nothing during play", game.gate_hp == 50.0 and game.state == Game.State.PLAYING)
	for i in 10:
		game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(100 + i * 100, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
	game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await _seconds(2.0)
	_check("the run is lost (setup for restart)", game.state == Game.State.LOST)
	_key(KEY_ENTER, true)
	_key(KEY_ENTER, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("Enter restarts after a loss", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.gate_hp == Tuning.GATE_HP)
	game.archer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT

2	extends Node2D
3	## The hero on the wall walk: slides along X only and fires on its own (GDD 5.1, 6.2).
4	## Aims at the nearest scarecrow inside the upward cone; holds fire when there is none.
5	
6	signal fired(arrow: Arrow)
7	
8	const ARROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/arrow.tscn")
9	
10	var arrows_parent: Node
11	var fire_cooldown := 0.0
12	
13	
14	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
15		var axis := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
16		position.x = clampf(position.x + axis * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * delta,
17				Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN)
18		fire_cooldown = maxf(fire_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
19		if fire_cooldown > 0.0:
20			return
21		var target := nearest_target()
22		if target:
23			_fire_at(target)
24			fire_cooldown = Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL
25	
26	
27	func nearest_target() -> Scarecrow:
28		var best: Scarecrow = null
29		var best_dist := INF
30		var half_cone := deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)
31		for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
32			var s := enemy as Scarecrow
33			if s == null or s.is_dead():
34				continue
35			var to := s.global_position - global_position
36			if absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) > half_cone:
37				continue
38			if to.length() < best_dist:
39				best_dist = to.length()
40				best = s
41		return best
42	
43	
44	func _fire_at(target: Scarecrow) -> void:
45		var arrow := ARROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Arrow
46		var from := global_position + Vector2(0, -24)
47		arrow.launch(from, target.global_position - from)
48		(arrows_parent if arrows_parent else get_parent()).add_child(arrow)
49		fired.emit(arrow)

2	extends Node2D
3	## A fire arrow: flies straight, hits the first scarecrow within ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, sets it burning.
4	
5	var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
6	var element: StringName = &"fire"
7	
8	
9	func launch(from: Vector2, direction: Vector2) -> void:
10		position = from
11		velocity = direction.normalized() * Tuning.ARROW_SPEED
12		rotation = velocity.angle() + PI / 2.0     # the sprite points up
13	
14	
15	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
16		if is_queued_for_deletion():
17			return
18		position += velocity * delta

## A fire arrow: flies straight, hits the first scarecrow within ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, sets it burning.

var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
var element: StringName = &"fire"


func launch(from: Vector2, direction: Vector2) -> void:
	position = from
	velocity = direction.normalized() * Tuning.ARROW_SPEED
	rotation = velocity.angle() + PI / 2.0     # the sprite points up


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	position += velocity * delta
	for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := enemy as Scarecrow
		if s and s.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= Tuning.ARROW_HIT_RADIUS:
			s.hit(Tuning.ARROW_DAMAGE, element)
			queue_free()
			return
	if position.y < -60.0 or position.x < -60.0 or position.x > Tuning.VIEW.x + 60.0:
		queue_free()
